messages:
Jordan H: Heads-up — PR #6142 is stuck on merge because the smoke suite is failing intermittently on macOS shard. Failing test: `render_snapshot_smoke.TestFontFallback`.
Maya P: I saw that. Failing only on the last two runs? :eyes:
Jordan H: Yep, two consecutive runs in the merge queue. Logs show an assertion in the renderer timeout, but local repro is flaky (passes locally most of the time).
Sam K: Can we do a targeted rerun of just the macOS smoke shard and hold merge if it fails again? I can watch the run.
Jordan H: Yes please — want to avoid a full rerun. If it passes twice in a row we can unfreeze.
ci-bot: buildkite: Triggered targeted rerun for PR 6142 — pipeline: smoke-macos-shard (job id: bk-7781). Link: https://buildkite.example/organizations/redwood/pipelines/smoke-macos/builds/7781
Taylor L: Quick thought — recent change touched font fallback ordering. If rerun flakes, we might need a snapshot update or to pin the seed.
Maya P: Jordan, can you paste the failing stack snippet? Even a small paste helps.
Jordan H: Sure — stack snippet:
```
AssertionError: expected glyph '—' but got fallback char '?' at render_engine.cpp:482
  at render_snapshot_smoke (tests/smoke/render_snapshot_smoke.cc:128)
```
Sam K: That looks like a non-deterministic mapping of fonts on CI agent. Could be font cache timing out. We hit that before with `FC_CACHE` warming.
oncall-bot: Note: macos-runner-12 (agent bk-runner-12) has had a flurry of font-cache warnings in the last 24h — see ops/infra/agents/alerts
Jordan H: Ran `fc-cache -v` locally, no issues. For CI I can try adding a small preflight step to warm the cache. Would that be acceptable for a quick hotfix? e.g., add a job step:
```
- command: |
    fc-cache -r || true
    sleep 2
```
Taylor L: That seems reasonable. If it stabilizes, we can keep it as a temporary mitigation and open a follow-up ticket to investigate agent image.
Maya P: Agreed. In the meantime if the targeted rerun passes twice, can we merge? Who will unfreeze the queue?
Sam K: I'll watch the rerun and unfreeze if we get two green. Jordan, add the temp preflight and push — I'll trigger one more rerun after.
Jordan H: Pushed a small commit with the `fc-cache` step. PTAL — (push id: a1b2c3d). Thanks!
ci-bot: buildkite: Rerun queued for smoke-macos-shard (bk-7782) triggered by Sam K. Status: running.
Sam K: bk-7782 looks green so far, starting a second run bk-7783.
Taylor L: Nice. If bk-7783 is green too, let's merge but create a follow-up issue: `infra: investigate macos runner font cache instability` and assign to Eng Infra.
Jordan H: bk-7783 ✅ — two green. Unfreezing merge queue now. :tada:
Maya P: Thanks everyone. Jordan — can you open that follow-up ticket and add logs from ops? We should capture agent id and timestamps.
Jordan H: Will do, creating ticket and tagging Eng Infra. Thanks for the quick help! :raised_hands:
